summaryZh: Jiang 实验室研究正常与癌症干细胞中的 RNA 和 DNA 编辑机制，以及编辑酶如何在不同细胞环境中受到调控。团队探索在实体瘤和血液恶性肿瘤的临床前模型中靶向这些通路，以发展癌症治疗策略。
researchQuestions: RNA和DNA编辑酶在不同细胞环境中如何受到调控？
如何在实体瘤和血液恶性肿瘤的临床前模型中靶向这些编辑通路？

evidence.quote: The Jiang Laboratory studies the molecular mechanisms of RNA and DNA editing in normal and cancer stem cells, how these editase enzymes are regulated in different cellular contexts, and how to target these pathways in pre-clinical models of both solid tumor and blood malignancies.
She is currently an Assistant Professor of Medicine in the Division of Regenerative Medicine at the University of California, San Diego.
